title: Logins
tooltip: Logins — saved username and password for this site
noneHere: No saved logins for this site.
notASite: Logins can't be saved for this page (it isn't an http(s) page).
pageChanged: The page changed: the form was opened for {formSite}, but the open page is now {now}. Saving was cancelled and the typed password was cleared.

onlyField.username: Only the username was filled (this page has no password field).
onlyField.password: Only the password was filled (no username field was found).

smallPrint: Passwords are stored in the Keychain of the Mac the engine runs on; they can't be read back from here, only filled into the page. Warning: an agent connected to this browser can read a filled password from the page.

access.confirm: Every fill asks for Keychain approval on the engine's Mac: other programs running as your user (agents included) can't read the password without your click. Choosing “Always Allow” in that dialog removes this protection for that login.
access.silent: Keychain doesn't ask for approval: passwords are protected only on disk, and any program running as this user (agents included) can read them.

waiting: Waiting for Keychain approval on the screen of the engine's Mac…
risk: Agents can drive this browser too; they can read the filled password.
riskNow: An agent is running in this project right now (a terminal or a background agent).
